column3: Close to the Hebrew; בְּסֵתֶר (“the shelter”) is rendered “the secret place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a plague of destructions” is rendered “the perilous pestilence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a shield and a wall” is rendered “shield and buckler,” and “faithfulness” “His truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְשִׁלֻּמַת (“the recompense”) is rendered “the reward.”
The Hebrew is abrupt (“for you, LORD, my refuge; the Most High you made your dwelling”); NKJV restructures it as “Because you have made the LORD, who is my refuge… your dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּאָהֳלֶךָ (“your tent”) is rendered “your dwelling.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he has loved me” is rendered “he has set his love upon Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “length of days” is rendered “long life.”
